description:
Create a new HTTP Request file named 'library_tests.http' in the 'LibraryClient' project. Inside this file, define and execute two requests against the local Library Service running at http://localhost:8081:

1. A GET request to '/api/books' to retrieve the list of books.
2. A POST request to '/api/books' to add a new book. The POST request must have a 'Content-Type: application/json' header and a JSON body with 'title', 'author', and 'year' fields.

Execute both requests using the 'Run' icon in the editor to verify they work. The server logs are monitored to verify execution.
